seed_panel.name: private-env
seed_panel.sha256_basis: gm_bench.benchmark_config.seed_panel_hash over the 32 seeds in execution order (comma-joined decimal); the same execution hash sota-v5 commits to.
seed_panel.artifact_panel_sha256_basis: gm_bench.agentic.publication.seed_panel_sha256 (canonical SHA-256 of the sorted seeds). A full panel row under results/agentic/ must carry exactly this panel.sha256.
seed_panel.hiding_commitment_basis: scripts/seed_panel_commitment.py commitment(): SHA-256 of '<salt>:<sorted comma-joined seeds>' with a fresh 32-byte salt held only in the escrow.

lineage.shared_prefix_purpose: Execution positions 1 to 29 are the frozen sota-v5 private panel in its committed order (config/sota_v5_lane.json seed_panel.sha256), so a model's 1.0 and 2.0 scores pair per seed.
lineage.new_seeds_drawn: 2026-09-22 local (2026-09-23T03:13:37Z) by scripts/draw_bench_v2_private_panel.py with generate_private_seeds from scripts/seed_panel_commitment.py, the generator that drew the sota-v5 panel: secrets.randbelow rejection sampling over [2**32, 2**63 - 1], excluding preset seeds, the 29 sota-v5 seeds, and public seeds 1 to 58 (dev, leaderboard, smoke, and the 48-seed calibration panel 11 to 58).
lineage.retired_commitment_not_checked: The retired 16-seed sota-v3 commitment (macos-keychain:gm-bench-sota-v3-private-panel) was not read, so its never-read status holds. A collision with it has probability below 1e-17 at this range.

seed_panel.owner_attestation_scope: Owner must attest that the three new seeds were drawn as recorded above and escrowed without being read or printed, that the 32-seed escrow reproduces every digest here, and that panel execution will use the exact committed values without post-data substitution. The launcher refuses to run a panel until this reads attested-before-seed-access.
seed_panel.frozen_record: Drawn and escrowed in one process: the v5 escrow was read and verified against config/sota_v5_lane.json, the three new seeds and a fresh salt were drawn in memory, the record (same shape as the v5 escrow record plus a lineage block) was added to the Keychain through security -i on standard input so no seed or salt reached a command line or a file, and the item was read back and compared before these digests were printed.
